description: DB integration: a Fixed line mixing unit and bundle services generates an invoice whose bundle_presentation snapshot has the subtitle, names, raw (unclamped, including 0/null configured) quantities, pricing basis and deterministic order, while parent/detail/fixed-detail rows, tax and totals equal the pre-feature baseline for the same data

DB integration: two consecutive periods with +2, -1, a newly added service and a removed service produce correct previousQuantity/comparison; first period records no_prior_period; a cancelled prior invoice is ignored
DB integration: regenerating a draft after a quantity change recomputes the snapshot, while editing the line's title/subtitle after finalizing leaves the issued invoice's rendering unchanged
DB integration: contract line update persists title/subtitle on a line with existing invoices, and template clone copies both onto the client line
DB integration: accounting export selector and /api/v1/invoices/{id}/items return the same parent-only lines and fields for an invoice with bundle snapshots as without

Unit: component builder maps snapshots — quantityChange null when not compared/unchanged, priced output gives allocated totals summing to the bundle total and unit rates only for unit-basis, unpriced output has no unitPrice/total keys, multi-period split vs collapse
Unit: mapDbInvoiceToWasmViewModel keeps bundle qty 1/rate=total, leaves snapshot-less invoices unchanged, and components appear in recurringItems, groupsByLocation and ticketPresentationRows
Unit: invoice model without the opt-in returns exactly today's charge shape; with opt-in attaches bundle_presentation and requested detail amounts
Unit: templateUsesComponentPricing is true for the Quantities and prices preset and custom bindings to component.total/unitPrice, false for the Quantities only preset and templates without childRows

Integration: PDF generation for a client assigned the bundle-quantities template builds a view model with no component prices, and for a client on a priced custom template includes them; MSP preview follows the rendered template
Unit: AST schema accepts childRows and rejects unknown props; evaluator yields no child rows for a missing source; transforms and aggregates over items are unchanged when childRows exist

Render: react renderer / server HTML for the screenshot scenario shows indented child rows, blanked parent Qty/Rate only on bundle rows, empty unmapped cells, green +2 and red −1, nothing for 0/null, and ordinary lines with qty/rate/amount
PDF: server-rendered PDF of a long invoice keeps bundle child rows readable across page breaks with repeated headers

Migration: standard-bundle-quantities renders the screenshot layout for the bundle sample and plain rows for an invoice without snapshots; existing standard template rows and a saved custom template AST are byte-identical after migration

Designer integration: enabling Bundle component rows with each preset, toggling quantity changes and blank-on-bundle columns, and remapping a cell updates the canvas from the bundles sample; save/reopen preserves childRows and the subtitle line

Preview: draft/recurring preview view model for a contract with a Fixed line equals the persisted invoice's bundle item and components; AutomaticInvoices dialog still shows its per-service operator breakdown

Client portal: for a client on the bundle-quantities template, the template view and InvoiceDetailsDialog show bundle sub-rows and their payloads contain no component price fields; for a client on a standard template the dialog is unchanged
UI: Fixed line Invoice text group in the live editor, wizard and template editor saves title and subtitle; REST API accepts and returns both and the regenerated MCP registry lists them
i18n: French document renders locale-formatted quantities, signed changes and period labels; new MSP keys exist in all locale packs and locale validation passes
